name: Frances “Fran” Adams
sources: Ancestry.com, U.S., World War II Draft Cards Young Men, 1940-1947
Obituary of Presley M. Adams, Reno Gazette-Journal, 11 Jan 1987 (Newspapers.com Obituary Index on Ancestry.com)

Frances Adams, aged 24 in the 1940 census (born about 1916), at Richmond, California; named as Presley's wife on his 1940 draft card and in his 1987 obituary.
